reviews.title: Exceptional hospitality and wonderful terrace view
reviews.comment: Stayed here for 3 nights during a regional conference. The staff at Rahnile went above and beyond to make our stay smooth. The evening terrace is so relaxing with cool breeze and good wine. Rooms are clean, hot water was consistent, and the location behind EEPCO is very convenient.

reviews.title: A welcoming, peaceful base for exploring Lake Tana
reviews.comment: We loved our time at RahNile Hotel. The reception team helped us organize an early morning boat trip to Ura Kidane Mehret monastery without any hassle. Dinner at the restaurant was authentic and tasty, and the room was quiet and well cared for.

reviews.title: Reliable business hotel with great meeting facilities
reviews.comment: Our NGO hosted a two-day workshop in their conference hall. Audio, seating, and tea breaks were executed smoothly. Fast Wi-Fi throughout the hotel and friendly service throughout our stay.

reviews.title: Exceptional evening terrace and warm hospitality
reviews.comment: The sunset terrace overlooking Lake Tana was unforgettable. The staff helped arrange our boat tour early in the morning and breakfast was rich and varied.

reviews.title: Warmest hospitality and lovely sunset views
reviews.comment: Our stay at Rahnile was wonderful. The rooms were impeccably prepared with fresh rose petals and swans, hot water worked reliably, and dinner on the terrace was delicious.
